item.title: (Typographically) Beautiful Tumblr Themes?
item.description:
I’ve been trying to find a Tumblr theme that makes good use of typography today, i.e. one where type is the main design element. (Bonus points for @font-face, Typekit, etc.)

Suggestions? (Thanks in advance.)
